diff --git a/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py b/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
index b97886c..c40c7be 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/javascript_templates.py
@@ -6,10 +6,11 @@ from .js_style_regex_expression import REGEX_TOKEN
 from .token_pattern import compiled_token_pattern, tokens_in_span
 
 
-# Skip lexical units before interpreting their quotes, backticks or braces.
 # JavaScript line comments end at any line terminator, even after a backslash.
+LINE_COMMENT = r'//[^\r\n\u2028\u2029]*'
+# Skip lexical units before interpreting their quotes, backticks or braces.
 _OPAQUE_CODE = (
-    r'/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n\u2028\u2029]*'
+    r'/\*.*?\*/|' + LINE_COMMENT +
     r'|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\''
     r'|' + REGEX_TOKEN
 )

 from .typescript import (
     NULLISH_COALESCING, OPTIONAL_ACCESS, TypeScriptReader)

 class TSXReader(TypeScriptReader):

     @js_style_regex_expression
     def generate_tokens(source_code, addition='', token_class=None):
         # Add support for TypeScript type annotations in JSX
-        addition = addition + \
+        addition = addition + "|" + LINE_COMMENT + \
             r"|(?:<[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)*>)" + \
             r"|(?:<\/[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)*>)" + \
             r"|(?:#\w+)" + \
diff --git a/lizard_languages/typescript.py b/lizard_languages/typescript.py
index a63b5e4..e7a980a 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/typescript.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/typescript.py
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ from .js_style_regex_expression import js_style_regex_expression
 from .javascript_bindings import JavaScriptBindings
 from .typescript_declarations import TypeScriptTypeAnnotationStates
 from .typescript_states import TypeScriptStates
-from .javascript_templates import template_tokens
+from .javascript_templates import LINE_COMMENT, template_tokens
 
 # One token, so each ? in ?? is not its own ternary decision.
 NULLISH_COALESCING = r"|(?:\?\?)"
@@ -72,8 +72,10 @@ class TypeScriptReader(CodeReader, CCppCommentsMixin):
     @staticmethod
     @js_style_regex_expression
     def generate_tokens(source_code, addition='', token_class=None):
-        # Private method (#), dollar ($), optional name (?), nullish (??).
-        addition = (addition + r"|(?:#\w+)" + r"|(?:\$\w+)"
+        # Line comment, private method (#), dollar ($), optional name (?),
+        # nullish (??).
+        addition = (addition + "|" + LINE_COMMENT
+                    + r"|(?:#\w+)" + r"|(?:\$\w+)"
                     + r"|(?:\w+\?(?![?.]))" + NULLISH_COALESCING
                     + OPTIONAL_ACCESS)
         yield from template_tokens(source_code, addition, token_class)

+    def test_line_comment_ends_at_its_line(self):
+        code = (
+            "function b(code) {\n"
+            "  return (\n"
+            "    code === 92 || // \\\n"
+            "    code === 45 || // -\n"
+            "    code === 32\n"
+            "  )\n"
+            "}\n"
+        )
+        for filename in ('a.js', 'a.ts', 'a.jsx', 'a.tsx'):
+            with self.subTest(filename=filename):
+                functions = analyze_file.analyze_source_code(
+                    filename, code).function_list
+                self.assertEqual([('b', 1, 7, 3, 7)],
+                                 [(f.name, f.start_line, f.end_line,
+                                   f.cyclomatic_complexity, f.nloc)
+                                  for f in functions])

+
